translations.Create, Display and Share \"old school\": Create, Display and Share "old school" albums for your photos, videos and panoramics, on your Nextcloud server.
translations.Relive your memories the way you used to:
Relive your memories the way you used to with paper albums: page after page, story after story.

**Souvenirs** lets you craft "old school" albums from the photos and videos already stored on your Nextcloud — and share them with the people who matter.

### ✨ What you can do

- 📖 **Browse albums like a book** — turn pages instead of scrolling through photo grids
- 🎨 **Create and edit albums** right from the web interface: pick your photos, arrange your pages, give each album a name and a date
- 🎬 **Mix media freely** — photos, videos, audio recordings and even 360° panoramas on the same page
- 🌐 **Explore panoramas** interactively thanks to the integrated 360° viewer
- 🔗 **Share with a simple link** — family and friends can enjoy your albums without a Nextcloud account
- 📴 **Keep working offline** — view and edit your albums without a connection, right in the browser; your changes are synced when the server is back
- 📱 **Pair with the [Souvenirs Android app](https://github.com/zorgluf/souvenirs-android)** to build albums on the go and sync them with your server
- ♻️ **Save space** — media already on your server is reused, not duplicated

### 🔒 Your souvenirs, your server
Albums are stored as plain folders and files on your own Nextcloud. No third-party service, no lock-in: your souvenirs stay yours.
translations.A Souvenirs album is a book: a series of: A Souvenirs album is a book: a series of pages, each one a composition of tiles.
translations.Editing is reserved to the owner of the: Editing is reserved to the owner of the album, from their own Nextcloud.
translations.In edit mode, the + button of a page add: In edit mode, the + button of a page adds media picked from your Nextcloud files or uploaded from this device. Several files at once each get their own page.
Albums can be viewed and edited offline. Changes are kept on this device and sent to the server when the connection is back.
translations.Shortcuts are ignored while you type in: Shortcuts are ignored while you type in a text or a form field.
translations.A book of pages. On your Nextcloud it is: A book of pages. On your Nextcloud it is a plain folder (under Souvenirs by default, changeable in your personal settings) holding album.json, the description of the pages, and a data folder with the media. The Souvenirs Android app reads and writes the same folder.

translations.One screen of the book, turned like a pa: One screen of the book, turned like a paper page. A page may also carry a soundtrack and a drawing on top of its tiles.
translations.A photo, a 360° panorama, a video or a t: A photo, a 360° panorama, a video or a text placed on a page, each with its own position and size, and for photos its own framing inside the tile.

translations.Turn the pages with the side arrows, the: Turn the pages with the side arrows, the dots at the bottom or the keyboard arrows. Click a photo to see it full size, click a video to play it large, and drag inside a 360° panorama to look around.

translations.Every page gets a toolbar to add media,: Every page gets a toolbar to add media, add text, paint over the page and switch between layouts. Click a tile to select it, then move it with its handle, resize it from its corners and reframe the photo inside. The + between pages inserts a page, the chevrons move it. Changes are saved as you go.
Menu › Start slideshow, or press Space.

translations.Each album you open is remembered on thi: Each album you open is remembered on this device: its pages and texts, a few kilobytes. From then on it can be opened and edited without a connection.
translations.Media are kept on the device only for th: Media are kept on the device only for the albums you choose, with the offline button of an album in the album list. The size of the download is shown first. Other albums show a placeholder instead of their media while offline. The offline button of the album list shows the space used and removes copies.
translations.On a slow or paid connection, switch on: On a slow or paid connection, switch on "Work offline" with the offline button of the album list. Souvenirs then uses no data at all: only the albums kept on this device can be viewed and edited, and your changes wait there. Switch it off, or use "Go online" in the album list, to send them.
translations.Edit as usual. Media can only be added f: Edit as usual. Media can only be added from this device, since your Nextcloud files cannot be browsed, and carry a small cloud until they are uploaded. Creating, deleting and sharing albums need a connection.
translations.As soon as the server can be reached aga: As soon as the server can be reached again, your changes are sent and those made elsewhere are fetched. The icon next to the menu, and the offline button of each album in the list, tell whether everything is synchronized, waiting to be sent, or in conflict.
translations.When the same part of an album - its nam: When the same part of an album - its name and date, its list of pages, or the content of a page - was changed both on this device and elsewhere, nothing is overwritten. The album becomes read-only and asks you which version to keep, part by part.
translations.Install Souvenirs from the menu of your: Install Souvenirs from the menu of your browser (Install, or Add to Home Screen) to start it like an app and to protect the offline copies from being cleared by the browser. Logging out clears them from this device, along with any change not sent yet: let the synchronization finish first.
